content:
The Billionaire’s Contract stands out by turning a familiar trope “contract marriage” into an emotional experience. Instead of focusing only on wealth and desire, it talks about authentic human vulnerability , a billionaire who fears love a lot more than failure, and a woman who values honesty and happiness over luxury. The story balances romance , genuine emotion and slow-burn chemistry, written in a dual first-person POV of the main characters, that lets readers feel and understand the emotions, trust and love of both characters from their POVs
